description: This file defines chat-related classes and state management logic for a Flutter app. It includes the ChatMessage data model and the ChatProvider class, which manages chat message state, initialization, and message sending, with support for mock data. It interacts with external services like MockChatService and uses ChangeNotifier for state updates.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Simple data model representing a chat message with id, sender, text, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatProvider
classes.description: State management class for chat messages, extending ChangeNotifier to update UI. Handles message initialization and sending, with mock data support.

methods.name: ChatMessage
methods.description: Constructor for creating a chat message.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Getter returns an unmodifiable list of chat messages.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes chat history, optionally with mock data, and sets the initialized flag.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a new message, adds it to the state, and optionally gets a mock reply.
